subject: rabbit
review_scope: Independent visual comparison of source-keys.png, design.png, revisions/keys-v1.png and source.json only. Four chronological still keys in 2x2 order; no normal-speed playback inspected and no motion approval.

timed_key_evidence.evidence: Source rabbit is partly emerging through the doorway with a narrow frontal/downward head view and an extended foreleg. Drawing preserves the doorway occlusion and narrow emerging pose, with connected head, ears and forelegs.

Source has landed facing near front, with forepaws separated and hind support behind. Drawing preserves that readable stance and doorway relationship, although its furry cheeks and chest are newly detailed.

Source turns to a seated right-facing profile with ears laid diagonally backward and feet supporting the body. Drawing matches this direction and support, but replaces the selected design’s spare, blunt angular silhouette with a round, tufted rabbit.
Source exits right with the head outside frame, rear body, tail and bent hind leg remaining. Drawing preserves the right-edge crop and connected rear-leg exit silhouette.

main_gap: The source action and key poses are retained, but the chosen QuickDraw rabbit’s very spare angular outline, blunt muzzle and simple torso are diluted by a generic rounded, shaggy character. Category recognizability is stronger than specific design recognizability.
bounded_repair: Perform one outer-contour simplification pass on the rabbit in all four keys: use the selected design’s blunt angular muzzle and simple unbroken body/ear contour vocabulary, removing the added fur serrations while keeping the existing poses, paws, occlusion and framing.
protected_strengths: Doorway entrance, landing, rightward turn and cropped exit remain legible in chronological keys.
Ear and limb attachment are coherent, and the seated key has clear supporting feet.
Fixed doorway and floor relationship retain the source’s camera/action staging.
